review_candidates.title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
review_candidates.description: Veel organisaties beschikken over Microsoft 365. Maar weinig organisaties halen er écht alles uit. Help ons de standaard neer te zetten voor moderne werkplekken. Bij Digital Survival Company , een premium Managed Service Provider in Nieuwegein met circa 130 collega's, helpen we klanten in onder meer overheid, kritieke infrastructuur, retail, verzekeringen en woningcorporaties om hun moderne werkplek continu slimmer, veiliger en toekomstbestendiger te maken. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Modern Workplace Engineer die niet alleen projecten uitvoert, maar actief bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Zie je iets dat beter kan? Dan verwachten we niet dat je er alleen iets van vindt, maar dat je helpt het te realiseren. Waarom deze rol? We groeien en professionaliseren onze Modern Workplace-dienstverlening. Als senior heb je invloed op: de standaarden die we hanteren de onboardingaanpak van nieuwe klanten de inzet van nieuwe Microsoft-functionaliteiten de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening de technische keuzes die we maken Je komt niet terecht in een omgeving waar alles al bedacht is. Juist daarom zoeken we iemand die wil bouwen, verbeteren en richting geven. Wat ga je doen? Je rol is een mix van projecten, doorontwikkeling én operatie: Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Microsoft-werkplekken Werken met Microsoft 365, Intune, Endpoint Management en Purview Uitvoeren van migraties, onboardings en complexe changes Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van standaarden en baselines Onderzoeken en toepassen van nieuwe Microsoft-functionaliteiten Adviseren van klanten over werkplek-, security- en compliancevraagstukken Technische keuzes maken, onderbouwen en uitdragen Bijdragen aan innovatie en de doorontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening Naast klantprojecten krijg je nadrukkelijk de ruimte om de dienstverlening van Digital Survival Company verder te brengen. Tegelijk hoort daar de dagelijkse realiteit van een MSP bij: soms schakel je snel op een incident of een klantvraag. Die combinatie maakt de rol afwisselend, goed om dat vooraf te weten. Dit type engineer zoeken we Je bent technisch sterk, maar dat alleen maakt je nog geen senior. Je neemt eigenaarschap. Je ziet verbeterkansen voordat anderen ze zien en pakt ze op. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologie, deelt kennis met collega's en helpt de organisatie vooruit. Je kunt klanten meenemen in technische keuzes en begrijpt wanneer je moet adviseren, wanneer je moet overtuigen en wanneer je juist een grens moet trekken. Je bent niet iemand die afwacht. Je bent iemand die bouwt. Dit neem je mee HBO werk- en denkniveau Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Modern Workplace-omgevingen Ervaring met Microsoft 365, Intune en Endpoint Management Kennis van Purview, Security & Compliance en moderne werkplekarchitecturen Ervaring met migraties, implementaties en complexe changes Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je beheerst het Nederlands goed in woord en geschrift. In het bezit van een rijbewijs B en bereid tot reizen naar klantlocaties. Ervaring binnen een MSP-omgeving is een pré Waarom Digital Survival Company? Bij veel organisaties implementeer je wat anderen bedacht hebben. Hier help je bepalen hoe het eruitziet. Je werkt met ervaren engineers die elkaar technisch uitdagen, kennis delen en continu verbeteren. Initiatief wordt gewaardeerd én krijgt ruimte om uitgevoerd te worden. Wat krijg je? 💰 Salaris tussen €4.500 en €7.000 per maand 🚗 Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget 🛡️ Premievrij pensioen 🎯 Jaarlijkse bonusregeling 📚 Volop ruimte voor opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen 🏠 Bijdrage aan je thuiswerkplek 🍽️ Dagelijks een versbereide lunch van onze eigen koks 🌴 25 vakantiedagen + 8% vakantiegeld 🚀 De vrijheid om invloed uit te oefenen op techniek, standaarden en dienstverlening Enthousiast? We kijken ernaar uit om met jou in gesprek te komen en meer over jou te weten! We ontvangen daarom graag jouw sollicitatie via de sollicitatiebutton of bel naar +31631004616. Voor vragen mag je natuurlijk ook even contact opnemen. Sollicitatieprocedure Na een eerste kennismaking volgt een verdiepend (technisch) gesprek. Onderdeel van de procedure voor deze seniorrol is een assessment. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Geen lange procedures of onnodige rondes. We houden het graag persoonlijk, transparant en praktisch.

review_candidates.title: Technical Generalist
review_candidates.description: Technical Generalist Cosmicport is a space-tech startup developing methalox rocket propulsion and launch systems from Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. We operate a cryogenic propulsion test facility and are building a team working at the frontier of Indian private spaceflight. We're looking for someone who can build and fix things across the company — software, systems, and whatever else needs building — in a fast-moving, engineering-driven environment. Role Summary: You'll be the person who tinkers, builds, and fixes — internal tools, trackers, integrations, small apps, the company website, even some marketing/content work when needed. You won't be doing deep propulsion engineering, but you'll work alongside engineers, picking up context fast and building whatever they need without hand-holding. This is a builder role for someone who's genuinely curious and doesn't want to be boxed into one lane. Educational Qualification: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Electronics, IT, or a related technical field. No specific certifications required — projects and demonstrated ability matter more than credentials. Responsibilities: Building & Systems Build and maintain internal tools, trackers, and small custom apps to support engineering, ops, and admin workflows. Set up and integrate systems (databases, dashboards, automations) with guidance from engineers — you don't need to design the architecture, but you should be comfortable implementing it. Handle general technical/IT admin: accounts, tools, basic troubleshooting, company website upkeep. Content & Outreach Help maintain the company website, write occasional articles or updates, and support outreach/BD conversations — this isn't a marketing hire, but comfort writing and representing the company matters. Support documentation — trackers, one-pagers, whatever needs to exist and doesn't yet. General Fill gaps across engineering support, admin, and ops — the role is deliberately broad; what you work on will shift based on what the company needs that week. Required Qualities: Strong coding fundamentals (Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar) and genuine comfort picking up new tools/languages as needed. Demonstrated project or work history building real things — apps, tools, automations, contributions (open source, personal projects, or work experience all count). Comfortable working with minimal direction — this is a "figure it out" role, not a "follow the ticket" role. Some exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), databases, or DevOps-adjacent tools is a plus. Willingness to be based full-time in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. Preferred Qualities: Experience across multiple domains (not just pure software) — someone who's dabbled in content, ops, or small business-side tasks alongside coding. Startup or small-team experience, where role boundaries were loose. Genuine curiosity — side projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, self-taught skills. Location: On-site — Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, India Experience Level: 0–3 years Compensation: Competitive, aligned with experience and ownership level Apply by sending your resume here, or to contact@cosmicport.com.

review_candidates.title: Production Lead Engineer for SaaS Platform
review_candidates.description: About the Role We’re looking for someone to be our point person and incident commander at night — the hours our platform runs but Jester and the daytime team aren’t on. Our platform (Autopilot) helps 2,000+ dental labs worldwide get their cases booked correctly within 15 minutes of arrival, every time, so when something breaks overnight, someone has to be ready with a fast, safe fix immediately — not by morning. This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management position. You won’t have direct reports. What you will have is real responsibility: you’re the one who owns incident response at night, and you make sure the same process and communication standard that runs during the day holds up just as well at 2am. You’ll also train one Application Support team member to be your trusted backup at night — someone you can delegate real tasks to, not just someone shadowing you. What You’ll Own Incident command at night. When something breaks overnight, you declare it, triage it, and drive it to resolution — the same triage-first standard used during the day, applied consistently after hours. Platform monitoring, day and night. Watch the health of every module and catch problems early, whatever the hour. Cross-shift consistency. Make sure the process, tools, and communication flow used at night match what’s used during the day — no gaps, no separate “night version” of how things get handled. Training your night backup. Work with Jester to identify one Application Support team member as your trained backup for night coverage. Teach them to run real triage and delegate real tasks to them — not just observation. A close partnership with DevOps. Work directly with Jester and his team on keeping infrastructure stable and building better tools to catch problems automatically. Knowing when — and when not — to escalate further. Most problems get fixed at your level. For the rare cases that genuinely need more, you know exactly who to call and how. What Success Looks Like The platform stays healthy well over 99% of the time, day and night. Night incidents are handled fast and correctly — Jester never has to be pulled in personally to cover a night incident. Your trained backup can run night triage confidently on their own when needed. The daytime team never has to “catch up” on what happened overnight — communication is seamless across the shift change. What We’re Looking For Experience as an individual contributor in a technical support or incident response role — SaaS, platform operations, or similar. Comfortable owning a decision under pressure, alone, without a manager to check with in the moment. Able and willing to be the primary owner of incidents at night — this is the core of the role, not an occasional ask. Some hands-on comfort with basics like service restarts, log review, and ticketing systems (we use Jira). Deep DevOps expertise is not required — that’s Jester’s team; you need to know enough to apply a safe first fix and know when to hand off. Able to teach and delegate to a peer effectively, even without formal management authority. Clear, calm communicator — you’ll be updating customer-facing teams during live incidents. How We’ll Set You Up to Succeed The first 90 days follow a structured ramp: you’ll spend real time learning the platform and the team before you’re expected to run night incidents solo, then build up to full independent night ownership — including a trained backup — by the end of your first month. Full details are in the accompanying 90-Day Plan.

Establish patterns for onboarding new source systems and delivering data to downstream vendor systems with strong reliability and traceability. Drive data quality controls (validation, reconciliation, exception handling) and operational runbooks. Platform engineering (multi-tenancy & scalability) Evolve the multi-tenant architecture: tenant isolation, configuration management, metadata-driven pipelines, and scalable runtime patterns. Optimise for performance, cost, and reliability across environments (dev/test/prod), including capacity planning and operational SLAs. Automation, CI/CD and release engineering Improve build and deployment automation for both platform services and Airflow DAGs (versioning, packaging, promotions, approvals). Implement CI/CD best practices: automated testing, static analysis, security scanning, and controlled rollout/rollback strategies. Reduce manual toil by investing in self-service onboarding, templates, and engineering enablement tooling. Data lineage & observability Implement end-to-end data lineage (source → platform → vendor), including metadata capture and a visual representation that supports auditability and faster incident resolution. Enhance observability across pipelines and services: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboards; drive measurable improvements in MTTR and change failure rate. Stakeholder management & ways of working Partner with product owners, data owners, architects, vendors, and governance teams to shape requirements and manage delivery expectations. CI/CD expertise (pipeline tooling, release controls, automated quality gates) and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (e.g., Terraform). Ability to translate complex technical topics for mixed audiences and drive alignment across teams. Experience integrating with external vendor systems and managing vendor technical dependencies. Consistent engineering standards and a team that’s growing capability and confidence over time. Working style A pragmatic, hands-on technical leader who enjoys getting things done, raises engineering standards without slowing delivery, and builds an inclusive team environment where different viewpoints improve outcomes.
